spans.s: चय r. 1st cl. (चयते) To go to or towards, to go, to move, भ्वा-आ-सक-सेट् ।

चय m. (यः)
 1. An assemblage, a multitude.
 2. A heap, a collection.
 3.
A mound of earth, raised to form the foundation of a building.
4. A rampart or mound of earth raised from the ditch of a fort.
5. The gate of a fort.
 6. Any edifice.
 7. A seat, a stool.
 8. A
cover, a covering.
 E. चि to collect, aff. अच्.

चाय (ऋ) चायृ r. 1st cl. (चायति-ते)
 1. To worship, to revere.
 2. To discern,
to perceive. भ्वा-सक-उभ-वेट् ।

चयन n. (-नं) Collecting, gathering.
 E. चि to collect, ल्युट् aff.

चयनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be collected or gathered.
 E. चि to collect,
अनीयर aff.
